acceptanceCriteria: Root cause of the silent miss is identified from the probe code (internal/tasks/cli doctor probes) and cited.

A probe that cannot observe the holder emits the TQD-V0-021 'probe incomplete' warning instead of returning an empty holder set, or the holder is reliably found; covered by a deterministic test with an injected probe result.
TestTQDV0021_RealProbes passes 50/50 under -race -count=50 on Linux with parallel load, with the result retained.
body: Suspected defect (one CI observation, not reproduced locally). Merge-queue run 39133588433 (PR #1081 group, base 950f30c3e) failed go-product-shard (5): internal/tasks/cli TestTQDV0021_RealProbes at doctor_ops_test.go:284. The doctor reported SLOW_QUEUE_COMMAND for the prepare-lock helper pid but NO QUEUE_LOCK_HELD finding for the flock holder of taskman.lock, and warnings were empty. The test only tolerates a missed finding when the probe emits 'probe incomplete' (TQD-V0-021), so a silent miss fails the test and ejected #1081 from the merge queue (removed_from_merge_queue 14:57Z), costing a full queue cycle; the same PR's own CI passed, so it is intermittent. Expected: the lock-opener probe either reports the holder or warns that it is incomplete; it never silently returns no holder. Actual: silent miss on a loaded Linux runner (likely the lock-holder probe racing /proc/locks or lsof output, or a probe timeout not mapped to the incomplete warning).
title: doctor real lock probe misses a held queue lock with no 'probe incomplete' warning (TestTQDV0021_RealProbes flake ejected #1081)
